title: Mountains
lede: Blue pen, brush and linocut mountains, cut out of their paper: a high peak, a small peak, a peak above mist, a range with contour lines, a 1934 ridge sketch, a brush ridge, and a linocut of peaks over waves. Each in the blue it was drawn in, cobalt and black; the linocut also in three lighter blues. A candidate look for a sub-brand.
use_for: Landscape and distance: a sub-brand look, covers, and grounds for titles.
colour_rule: The blue each was drawn in, cobalt or black. The drawn blues are for the mountains only: don't retint the mountains, and don't print other graphics in those blues.
notes: Pen and brush drawings are PNG only: their transparency follows the ink, so light hatching stays light.

elements.title: High peak
elements.desc: A single steep peak in dense ballpoint hatching, with clouds and a stand of pines.

elements.title: Small peak
elements.desc: A compact peak in quick violet-blue ballpoint strokes. Holds up at small sizes.

elements.title: Grid peak
elements.desc: A tall peak above a band of mist, in fine lines. The grid paper behind it is removed and the base fades out softly.

elements.title: Contour range
elements.desc: A whole range of peaks in pen, with contour lines drifting through the sky. Busy, so best large or as a background.

elements.title: 1934 ridge
elements.desc: A ridge sketched on the spot in parallel hatching, dated 26 September 1934. The handwritten note is removed.

elements.title: Brush ridge
elements.desc: A loose ridge in bold brush strokes and watery wash. The paler wash stays semi-transparent, so the ground shows through it.

elements.title: Peaks and waves
elements.desc: Jagged peaks over curling waves, a bold linocut. Ink only: the sky and the map it was printed on are removed. The lighter blues suit pale grounds and backgrounds.

elements.title: Peaks and waves on a map
elements.desc: The same linocut keeping the old map inside the mountains; only the sky is removed. The black is the original print.
